resources.string: “%1$s” wants to use Hexis Voice for speech-to-text.\n\nThe microphone and recording stay inside this addon — only the recognized text is sent back. You can revoke this anytime in Hexis → Settings → Addon bridges.
Pick the voice-model file — or select all its parts at once if it was split for transfer. It\'s copied into this addon\'s private storage; nothing is sent anywhere.
That file isn\'t a valid voice model (expected a Whisper .bin).

Android wouldn\'t let the addon read that file. It\'s on storage apps can\'t reach (a USB/MTP transfer or an SD card). Save both parts to this phone\'s internal Download folder — e.g. download them again directly on the phone, or in the Files app copy them to Internal storage › Download — then pick them from there.
Tap the mic and speak — the text is typed into the field.
Install a voice model in Hexis → Settings → Addon bridges first.
